description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and a metric represented on the y-axis for different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and has a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with no explicit label provided. 

The first line, colored blue and marked with circles, begins at approximately y=24 when x=200 and decreases to approximately y=22 when x=900. The second line, colored red and marked with circles, starts at approximately y=28 when x=200 and decreases to approximately y=25 when x=900. The third line, colored green and marked with circles, begins at approximately y=31 when x=200 and decreases to approximately y=28 when x=900. The fourth line, colored yellow and marked with circles, starts at approximately y=31 when x=200 and decreases to approximately y=11 when x=900.
